title: Testosterone is OVERRATED
summary: NH argues that fitness YouTube's obsession with testosterone, along with the claim that modern men are biologically low-T, is a black-pill excuse that strips men of responsibility for their physiques. He blames enhanced influencers and supplement sellers for creating the fear and pushing boosters and TRT on young men, and insists that long-term training and diet build both the physique and healthy hormone levels.
claims: Fitness YouTube sells testosterone as the answer to every male problem while telling young men they are cursed with low T, a combination that discourages them

The claim that men's testosterone halved in about 100 years cannot be explained by biology; evolution cannot change a species in a century, so modern men are biologically like the drug-free bodybuilders of 100 years ago
Many naturals, NH included, have built big physiques; writing them off as steroid users or genetic outliers is how the black pill protects itself
Obsessing over testosterone is an excuse that lets men who do not train hard or diet properly blame things outside their control
He accepts that average muscle mass and T levels appear to be falling, but blames environment and lifestyle, not genetics
Low T is mostly the result of lifestyle choices: food, hobbies and media; black-pill content is anti-anabolic because it comforts you into not working
About ten years ago fitness YouTube talked about training and diet; enhanced athletes and masculinity gurus planted testosterone as a third factor and then sold the cure
For a worried young man, getting a blood test for T is usually a bad idea: it tends to confirm the fear and leads to quitting, buying boosters or starting TRT
Testosterone boosters are snake oil, usually sold by the same enhanced people who spread the fear, like old market charlatans who used planted accomplices
Most people on TRT today are not men in their 50s or 60s or with real hypogonadism, but young men with healthy levels that are merely below average
TRT is replacement, not optimisation: injecting testosterone shuts down your natural production
People who say TRT just restores natural levels always pick the top of the normal range, and anyone on TRT ends up above even the top 0.01% of naturals
Masculinity gurus pushing TRT are killing masculinity: injecting is the easy way out, can make you infertile, and can kill natural production for a whole generation
Hormonal dysphoria: constant talk of high T leads naturals to see any normal level as low
Big naturals, NH included, likely have average or slightly above-average T; he had a blood test scheduled for August to check his levels
You do not need to be gifted to build muscle, but it takes about 10 years of hard work, and he thinks only 2-3% of young men would commit to that
A training session does more for your physique than a T booster, and nutrition does more than supplements; focusing on T pulls attention from training and recovery
If you want high T, train for a long time; the physique comes first and better hormones follow
Average to above-average natural testosterone is plenty to build a good physique
Schrodinger's genetics: people who stick with training and diet end up called genetically gifted and high T, while those who quit get labelled low T, a result they created themselves
In 2016-17 NH thought he had hit his natural limit, blamed his T levels and seriously considered taking drugs
Blaming your body for low T insults the ancestors who produced you; you pilot your body like a car, and if it breaks down it is the driver's fault
